name: popsicle
headline: Stacker - Automates Marketing Content Distribution
short_description: Stacker automates marketing content distribution across social channels. It extracts content from Vellum and republishes via Buffer to Twitter, Mastodon, Facebook, and LinkedIn. Marketing teams benefit from automated content distribution and generated leader copy.
author: endjin

sections.overview:
Stacker is a .NET global tool that streamlines marketing content distribution by automating the republication process across Twitter, Mastodon, Facebook, and LinkedIn. It extracts content from Vellum and uses Buffer to schedule posts with automatically generated leader copy, eliminating manual cross-posting workflows. The tool supports advanced filtering by tags, date ranges, and publication periods, plus WordPress export functionality for converting blog posts to markdown or universal formats. Marketing teams use Stacker to maintain consistent social presence without repetitive manual tasks, while buffer shuffle functionality allows mixing newly queued content with existing schedules.
Automatically republish blog content across Twitter, LinkedIn, Facebook, and Mastodon
Convert WordPress exports to markdown or universal formats for social distribution
Filter and schedule content by tags, dates, and publication periods
Shuffle buffered content queues to randomize post order across platforms
